reviews.text: Fast delivery, cable looks well built. Charging my Samsung at full speed. Happy with the purchase!
Good cable, charges fine. The braided design is nice. Only 4 stars because the packaging was slightly damaged.

reviews.noise_reason: No product-specific content. Contains promotional spam link and generic exclamation.

reviews.text: Works great with my Pixel phone. Solid build quality. Transferring files is also fast.
Cable works but I noticed it gets warm when charging for more than 30 minutes. Not sure if that is normal. Keeping an eye on it.
Disappointed. The cable started getting noticeably hot near the USB-C connector after about an hour of use. Had to unplug it. This does not feel safe.
I have been using TechMart cables for months and they are always great. This one is no different. Solid build, fast charging, no issues at all. Highly recommend!
reviews.noise_reason: Purchase date 2024-11-19 predates batch B2024-11 arrival on 2024-11-20. Customer received batch B2024-09.

reviews.text: The connector housing became very warm to touch after 45 minutes of charging my laptop. I measured it with an infrared thermometer at 62C. That is way too hot for a USB-C cable. Returning this.
Mixed feelings. It charges fine at first but after 20-30 minutes the cable area near the plug gets warm. Not super hot but warmer than my old cable.

DANGEROUS! The cable connector partially melted while charging my phone overnight. There are visible burn marks on the cable and on my phone case. I am filing a complaint with consumer protection. DO NOT BUY THIS CABLE.
Cable overheats badly. I left it charging for an hour and the connector was too hot to touch. My kid could have burned herself. Returning immediately.
Worst cable I have ever purchased. Smelled burning plastic after 40 minutes of use. The connector tip has scorch marks. This is a fire hazard. TechMart needs to recall this batch immediately.

DANGEROUS! The cable connector partially melted while charging my phone overnight. There are visible burn marks on the cable and on my phone case. I am filing a complaint with consumer protection. DO NOT BUY THIS CABLE.
reviews.noise_reason: Identical text to REV-010 by KhalidJ. Different username but same content verbatim.

reviews.text: I bought two cables from this batch. Both get very hot near the connector. One of them has started making a slight crackling sound when charging. Extremely concerned.
The cable damaged the USB-C port on my Samsung tablet. Connector was so hot it warped slightly. Now my tablet will not charge properly with any cable.
Got the cable yesterday. Seems fine so far. Charges my iPhone quickly. Will update if I notice any heating issues like others are mentioning.
Third day and the cable is already showing heat discoloration near the connector. My wife cable from the same order has the same problem.
The cable works but it is clearly defective. Gets too hot within 20 minutes. I checked online and other people are having the same issue. This seems like a batch problem.
I smell electrical burning within 30 minutes of use every single time. This is NOT safe. My old TechMart cable from months ago works perfectly fine. It is definitely this new batch.

Overheating issue confirmed. I am an electrical engineer and I measured 68C at the connector after 35 minutes of 65W charging. Normal should be under 45C. There is clearly a resistance problem in this batch connectors.
Just got the cable. Seems fine so far. Charges my iPhone quickly. Will update if I notice any heating issues like others are mentioning.
I was charging my phone on my desk at work when a colleague noticed smoke coming from the cable. The connector had partially melted. This is extremely dangerous.
DO NOT BUY. My cable melted the charging port on my brand new laptop. The repair quote is Rs 15000. TechMart customer service says they need to investigate.
Fourth person in my office to have this problem. We all bought from the same TechMart listing last week. Every single cable overheats. One already melted. We are all returning.
